title: Hiking Gift Coupons Printable, Experience Gift for Hiker, Last Minute Gift, Coupon Book PDF, Trail Pass, Gift for Him Her, Adventure Gift
description:
A last-minute gift for anyone who loves hiking, or wants to start: write-in coupons for hikes you will take together, a trail pass to reveal the plan and a simple planning page, so the gift turns into a real day outside. No Canva or editing account needed. Print, write and wrap the same day.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 24 hike-together coupons, 6 per page: sunrise hike, waterfall hike, first snow walk, I carry the snacks, I drive to the trailhead, picnic at the top, stargazing walk, hot chocolate after, and more. Each has To, From and Valid until
- 8 blank write-in coupons for your own ideas
- 6 kids and family coupons and 6 winter coupons
- Trail Pass reveal cards and a full-page gift certificate for a day hike guided by you
- Plan-the-hike page (distance in miles and km, elevation in ft and m, turnaround time, weather check), a what-to-bring checklist, beginner tips and an 'Our hike' memory page
- A fold-and-glue envelope, gift tags, a gift card and print-and-assemble ideas

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Prints well on card stock or plain paper, in color or black and white. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
sub: 44 printable coupons, a trail pass and a gift certificate. Print it and give it today.
